measurements.footprint_bounds_method: Bounds of the raw GIS polygon after documented local approximate conversion; plan extents approximately 54.63 m east-west by 42.18 m north-south.
measurements.vertical_extent_status: Estimated envelope: existing massing object in modular manifest has a 0 to 16 m vertical envelope; official emergency plan confirms floors basement through third plus attic but publishes no heights. Story heights, attic/service penthouse, and roof are illustrative estimates, not measurements.
measurements.orientation: Inherited exactly from the GIS coordinate polygon and its campus transform; no image-based facade azimuth verification was available.
measurements.placement_check: Adding local model XY bounds to the stated anchor returns campus bounds [-182.325,-127.353] X and [-840.335,-797.590] Y; extra extent beyond the GIS wall footprint comes from decorative window, belt, roof and cornice geometry, not whole-asset rescaling.
measurements.source_area_note: Raw geographic ring converted with the project approximate formula has shoelace area 1125.023 m². ArcGIS Shape.STArea() is 1944.517 in its native EPSG:3857/Web Mercator spatial reference, whose area is inflated by latitude scale distortion; do not interpret that field as ground area.

model_method: Extruded the GIS outline as three visible above-grade floors with procedural masonry, regular estimated window bays, stone story bands/cornice, and a simple roof/attic volume. Included generic interior floor plates only; avoided inventing room partitions because no plan was available. One named building object resides in the expected asset collection. Preview camera/light are outside the asset collection.
uncertainty: No georeferenced current facade/street imagery or elevations were located in accessible evidence during this build. Brick tone, window pattern, stone trim, roof treatment, entrance bay positions, detailed height and internal plan are visual estimates.
GIS footprint identifies the correct campus asset but is not represented as a surveyed foundation plan.
The emergency-plan elevator side and exits support general features only; their exact coordinates are not known.
